verdict.rationale: BugSnag is an error-monitoring SaaS, so an official MCP server applies, and one exists: SmartBear (BugSnag's parent) publishes an official MCP server, and BugSnag's changelog adds OAuth 2.0 browser login for the self-hosted MCP server in place of manual API tokens. The evidence is thin, though: a probe link and a single changelog line. Missing for 10: documentation of which BugSnag tools or data the MCP server exposes, in-depth first-party setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity.
